name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is an early-stage gold and silver explorer based in Reno, Nevada, focused on acquiring and exploring mineral properties in Nevada's Walker Lane shear zone. Its flagship Agai-Pah property in Mineral County covers 162 hectares and has returned high-grade surface silver assays from exposed mineralized veins. The company also holds the Loman, Swales, Belshazzar, and Palmetto properties in Nevada.
